title: Drifter Bar Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry by Drifter Bar Salts brings together three luscious fruits in a vibrant, layered vape. Sweet, juicy Strawberry forms the base, lifted by the sharp tang of Raspberry and the deep, tart notes of Cherry. It’s a rich and satisfying fruit medley, bursting with bold flavour on every puff. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Blueberry and Cherry to Blackcurrant Ice, to Watermelon Strawberry Bubblegum and Lime Raspberry Cherry, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
